title: SVARTULFRVERSE WORLD TEMPLATE
description: MacroCosmo master-template per lore estesa, timeline globale e adattazione dinamica del testo. Il file originale non gestisce memoria persistente: delega lo stato all'Engine e usa solo le informazioni fornite dal runtime context.

contextContract.sandboxContract: ES6-safe JanitorAI Scripts API: scope locale, context guard, append-only writes e nessuna API hard-blocked.

entries.title: Example Location 0x01
entries.description: Schema example from the original World Template. It is not active lore in the source file because it appears inside a commented example array. Replace the placeholders with concrete location facts while preserving attribution and Canon Layer.

full.personality: , aware of the concrete example location
full.scenario: [ACTIVE] LOC Source: world/example_location_0x01.md. Add concrete location facts here.

summary.scenario: [ACTIVE] LOC Source: world/example_location_0x01.md. Compact location summary here.

bullet.scenario: [ACTIVE] LOC Source: world/example_location_0x01.md. Bullets: concrete facts only.

entries.title: World Runtime: Complex Lorebook
entries.description: Runtime mechanic that scans recent messages, selects lore entries by direct keyword match, priority, importance and mention count, then appends full, summary or bullet content to personality and scenario.

entries.title: World Runtime: Adaptive Lorebook
entries.description: Runtime mechanic that activates additional mentioned entries within the World budget. It degrades detail from full to bullet when token pressure requires it, then stops before exceeding the budget.

entries.title: World Runtime: Timeline Events
entries.description: Runtime mechanic activated by **Timeline:** or **Timeline Index:** in the last response. It applies timeline events within their min/max timeline and message-window constraints.

entries.title: World Runtime: Stat Reactions
entries.description: Runtime mechanic that reads named stats from the last response and appends personality/scenario reactions when the stat value satisfies configured min/max constraints.

entries.title: World Runtime: Cascade Activation
entries.description: Runtime mechanic that activates child lore entries from an active entry's cascade.children list. It repeats until no new children can be activated.

entries.title: World Runtime: Debug Output
entries.description: Optional debug mechanic that appends compact diagnostic lines to scenario when WORLD_FEATURES.DEBUG_MODE is true.

utilityFunctions.name: appendIfMissing
utilityFunctions.purpose: Aggiunge testo a personality, scenario o example_dialogs solo se non è già presente.

utilityFunctions.name: escapeRegExp

utilityFunctions.name: countMentions

utilityFunctions.name: getRecentText

utilityFunctions.name: clampBudget

utilityFunctions.name: getWorldBudget

utilityFunctions.name: extractTimelineIndex

utilityFunctions.name: extractStatValue

activationFunctions.name: getSourcePrefix

activationFunctions.name: sortActiveEntries

activationFunctions.name: applyCascadeActivation

activationFunctions.name: applyStatReactions

activationFunctions.name: applyTimelineEvents

activationFunctions.name: applyComplexLorebook

activationFunctions.name: applyWorldDebug

sourceNotes: Compatibile con ES6-safe JanitorAI Scripts API: usa solo scope locale, context guard, append-only writes e nessuna API hard-blocked.
Ogni entry deve includere source e canonLayer.
Sostituire gli esempi vuoti con lore concreta, mantenendo attribuzione e layer.
Gli eventi timeline sono attivati da **Timeline:** o **Timeline Index:**.
Esempio stat reaction: { stat: "example_stat", min: 2, personality: "", scenario: " [ACTIVE] ORG Source: world/org.md. ..." }
